US8509827B2.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data.

Context-Data Acquisition And Ranking.description: A method and system for determining a context-data type from a query, identifying context-data sources, generating requests for context data, and ranking received context data according to specified parameters.

Context-Data Type.description: A classification of context data determined from a query, where the type is determined by the meaning of a term of a short message and provides information about an environment of a mobile device.

Context-Data Source.description: A source that provides a particular context-data type and from which context data is requested and acquired.

Short Message.description: A message received from a mobile device by a server, from which a context-data type is determined and to which received context data may be appended or associated.

Mobile Device.description: A device that generates a short message and a query, and to which received context data may be provided.

Server.description: A server that receives a short message from a mobile device and performs context-data acquisition and ranking.

Recipient Mobile Device.description: A mobile device that receives context data, short messages, and forwarded messages with associated context data.

Specified Parameter.description: A parameter used to rank context-data sources, which may include a pecuniary cost to acquire context data, a state of the receiving mobile device, or a state of an available communication network.

Pecuniary Cost.description: A specified parameter representing the monetary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source.

Database.description: A database available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored.

Database Server.description: A server whose Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device to access stored context data.

Uniform Resource Identifier (URI).description: An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device.

Markup Language.description: A language used to encode received context data into a short message.

Metadata Instructions.description: Instructions appended to a short message to query a database for received context data.

Communication Network.description: An available communication network whose state may serve as a specified parameter for ranking context-data sources.

records.description: The patent document US8509827B2 discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture of context-data acquisition and ranking.
The context-data acquisition and ranking method algorithmically determines a context-data type from a query.
The method identifies at least one context-data source that provides the context-data type and generates a request for context data from that source.
The method algorithmically ranks context-data sources according to a specified parameter.
The method receives a short message from a mobile device with a server and determines a context-data type from a term of the short message.
The method provides received context data to the device that generated the short message.
The method provides received context data to a recipient mobile device.
The method stores received context data in a database available to a recipient mobile device.
The method forwards a Uniform Resource Identifier of a database server to the receiving mobile device.
The method encodes received context data into the short message with a markup language.
The method appends metadata instructions to query the database for received context data in the short message.
The context-data type is determined by the meaning of a term of the short message.
The context-data type provides information about an environment of the mobile device.
The context-data source provides the context-data type.
The specified parameter comprises a pecuniary cost to acquire context data from the context-data source.
The specified parameter comprises a state of the receiving mobile device.
The specified parameter comprises a state of an available communication network.
The short message is generated by the mobile device.
The short message and the received context data are forwarded to the recipient mobile device.
The database server is identified by a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI).
